description: Search Yandex Maps for businesses, fetch full business cards, or collect reviews. Cookieless: no login, API key, cookies or browser are needed.

bbox.description: Optional rectangular area, for example '37.45,55.65,37.85,55.85'. Results outside the rectangle are dropped.
bbox.title: Bounding box (west,south,east,north)

businessIds.description: Yandex Maps organization IDs, one per line. Use for getDetails or getReviews.
businessIds.title: Business IDs

categoryIds.description: Optional Yandex category IDs, one per line. The category ID appears in each place's categoryDetails. Used server-side in searchPlaces and verified client-side.
categoryIds.title: Category IDs

city.description: City name in any language, for example 'Moscow', 'Kazan' or 'Istanbul'. Yandex Maps resolves the city centre and passes it to the search.
city.title: City

coordinates.description: Optional point for a local search, for example '55.7558,37.6173'. When set, it overrides the city centre. Combine with Radius to search around the point.
coordinates.title: Centre point (latitude,longitude)

goodPlace.description: Yandex Good Place quality filter. Used as a server-side search filter and verified client-side on place records.
goodPlace.title: Only Good Place businesses

language.description: Interface and metadata language. Review text stays in the reviewer's language and translations are returned separately.
language.title: Language

maxConcurrency.description: How many business pages or review batches to process at once. Higher is faster but more likely to trigger rate limiting.
maxConcurrency.title: Maximum concurrent requests

maxItems.description: Run-wide cap. In searchPlaces and getDetails it counts places; in getReviews it counts reviews across all businesses.
maxItems.title: Maximum records

maxPagesPerQuery.description: Yandex returns 25 businesses per page. More pages find more places but take longer.
maxPagesPerQuery.title: Maximum search pages per query

maxReviewsPerPlace.description: Review cap for each business. Yandex exposes up to 600 reviews per sort order; the actor combines four orders to reach up to 2,400 unique reviews per business.
maxReviewsPerPlace.title: Maximum reviews per place

minRating.description: Drop businesses below this rating. Businesses without a rating are dropped when a threshold is set. Applies to place records.
minRating.title: Minimum place rating

minReviewCount.description: Drop businesses with fewer text reviews. 0 disables the filter. Applies to place records.
minReviewCount.title: Minimum place review count

mode.description: What to collect. searchPlaces finds businesses by keyword. getDetails returns full business cards for IDs or URLs. getReviews collects customer reviews for IDs, URLs or a search.
enumTitles: Get business details for IDs or URLs
Get reviews for businesses or a search
mode.title: Mode

openNow.description: Keep only businesses that Yandex reports as open at collection time. Applies to place records.
openNow.title: Only open businesses

priceCategories.description: Keep businesses in any of these price bands. Leave empty for all prices. Server-side in searchPlaces, verified client-side elsewhere.
priceCategories.title: Price categories

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. The actor works without a proxy and negotiates access automatically. Supply a proxy only if you want to pin a specific country or provider.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

radiusKm.description: Keep only places within this distance of the centre point or city centre. Results are measured by straight-line distance and filtered strictly.
radiusKm.title: Radius (km)

requirePhone.description: Drop businesses without a phone number. Applies to searchPlaces and getDetails.
requirePhone.title: Only businesses with a phone

requireWebsite.description: Drop businesses without a website. Applies to searchPlaces and getDetails.
requireWebsite.title: Only businesses with a website

reviewDateFrom.description: Keep reviews published on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).
reviewDateFrom.title: Reviews from date

reviewDateTo.description: Keep reviews published on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).
reviewDateTo.title: Reviews to date

reviewMaxRating.description: Keep only reviews with at most this many stars (1-5).
reviewMaxRating.title: Maximum review rating

reviewMinRating.description: Keep only reviews with at least this many stars (1-5).
reviewMinRating.title: Minimum review rating

reviewRequireOwnerReply.description: Keep only reviews where the business wrote a reply.
reviewRequireOwnerReply.title: Only reviews with an owner reply

reviewSort.description: Primary review order. When you ask for more than 600 reviews per place, the actor also walks the other three orders and merges them, removing duplicates.
reviewSort.title: Review sort order

reviewTextContains.description: One phrase per line. A review is kept when its text contains any of these phrases, ignoring case.
reviewTextContains.title: Review text contains

searchQueries.description: One query per line, for example 'coffee' or 'dentist'. Used by searchPlaces, and by getReviews when no business IDs or URLs are supplied.
searchQueries.title: Search queries

startUrls.description: Yandex Maps organization URLs, short links or search URLs, one per line. Business and search URLs work in both getDetails and getReviews.
startUrls.title: Business or search URLs

yandexDomain.description: Regional Yandex domain. yandex.com works worldwide; regional domains return local metadata.
yandexDomain.title: Yandex domain

title: Yandex Maps Scraper Input
